impressions.text: The delivery addressed replayed handover comments that reverted owner board moves during the cursor overlap window.
The worker reported adding per-comment Progress markers and regression tests for all four handover tags, including overlap polls, watcher restart, and a later owner move.
The worker reported passing the test suite and listed checks, and the orchestrator reported green CI on the current head.
The worker noted that the expected prerelease warning did not establish permission protection and that npm ci reported two low-severity dependency vulnerabilities.
